name: medicare-ai
description: MediCare AI - Full-Stack AI-Powered Medical Assistant Web Application (MERN)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan.bold,magenta.bold "npm run server" "npm run client:wait"
scripts.client:wait: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health --timeout 120000 --interval 500 && npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
